deal_value.notes: $76.5M cash plus $10M of Porch common stock at closing; Porch guaranteed the $10M of stock would double in value by end of 2024 for shares retained by sellers. HousingWire headline reported the deal as ~$90M.

calculable.calculation: $86.5M closing consideration ($76.5M cash + $10M stock) / $15M company-expected 2022 revenue = 5.77x
inputs: Closing consideration $76.5M cash + $10M stock - Porch Group press release, Oct 27, 2021: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2021/10/27/2322103/29193/en/Porch-Group-Acquires-Floify-a-Leading-SaaS-Provider-for-Loan-Officers.html (also filed as SEC 8-K Ex-99.1: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1784535/000110465921130469/tm2130777d1_ex99-1.htm)
Floify expected 2022 revenue of $15M (130% net revenue retention as of Q2 2021) - same press release
calculable.caveats: Revenue basis is the company's forward 2022 estimate stated at announcement (Oct 2021), not audited actuals. The stock-guarantee feature and HousingWire's ~$90M headline suggest effective total consideration could be modestly higher than $86.5M. Consideration is purchase price, not a debt-adjusted EV (private target).
